svg.aria-label: VANI Smriti system architecture: 11 data sources are built into a Neo4j context graph, rendered into a 700-token seller.md, read by a Sarvam voice agent at call start through a Cloudflare tunnel, and written back during the call; the VANI Smriti page holds the call through the Sarvam Web SDK and shows every change live.
svg.text: One memory per seller, built from 11 sources, read by a Sarvam voice agent at call start and written back while it talks.

g.text: merge by ID · index by seller GLID

svg.text: Fact · Decision → linked to their source
indexed by seller GLID · one MERGE per write

g.text: • hydrate one seller in one read
tools · md diff · graph diff · end

svg.text: one Neo4j transaction per tool call

g.text: STT → LLM → TTS · Hindi, English, Telugu
during call: request · meeting · callback · dnc
Page asks the server for a signed URL; the server adds the API key
Browser ⇄ Sarvam: live audio over WebSocket, with the seller's GLID
Service reads the seller from Neo4j and renders seller.md (~140 ms)
VANI opens with call_reason, e.g. "a buyer from Patiala is waiting…"
New Fact + VaniSession in one Neo4j transaction; file re-rendered (< 200 ms)
Live feed pushes the tool call, md diff and graph diff to the page
Call ends: transcript saved; the next call opens with the follow-up
read the memory / render the file
